source_review.observed: Idle quarter frames show a readable small muzzle/neck change with stable broad shoulder silhouette. Feed crouches low and Sleep curls onto the side.
source_review.follow_up: Feed38 and Sleep50 crop fingers/extremities at the lower frame edge; source camera is insufficient for complete hand/floor clearance review.

source_review.observed: Idle glance is restrained. Feed stands much more upright; Sleep is supine, so the states remain visually distinct.
source_review.follow_up: Feed exposes sharp upward waist/abdominal panels; compare retained pose before classifying a new garment defect. Sleep feet are cropped; floor contact is unassessed.

source_review.observed: Helmet/shoulder movement is very subtle; Feed bends deeply and Sleep is supine while retaining the armor silhouette.
source_review.follow_up: Sword hilt appears offset above the closed fist in Idle25/75 and Feed38/61. Verify retained versus candidate hand/socket alignment; Sleep boot tips are cropped.

source_review.observed: Head inclination changes slightly around the bell in idle; Feed bows toward the opening.
source_review.follow_up: Sleep50 tips the bell above the supine torso with substantial visible separation; compare retained attachment and pose before acceptance. No source contact claim.

source_review.observed: Arms and crown shift minimally while large feet and trunk silhouette remain steady.
source_review.follow_up: Feed and Sleep remain near the standing idle silhouette; full-cycle/game-distance readability is not established by these stills.

source_review.observed: Small wing-tip/neck changes are visible; the wing membrane silhouette remains continuous in inspected views.
source_review.follow_up: All inspected states retain fully spread wings, including Sleep; the folded-wing intent is not demonstrated. Feed reads near alert idle. Held for a real wing-rest/feeding revision review.

source_review.observed: Quarter-phase antler/neck positions differ subtly; Sleep lowers the head/body and bends the front legs.
source_review.follow_up: Feed38 head remains high and resembles idle; a feeding/contact interpretation and floor clearance need contextual/full-cycle review.

source_review.observed: Anterior head/jaw and body curvature differ slightly between quarter phases; Sleep lowers the broad head while ring silhouette stays continuous.
source_review.follow_up: Small substrate-probe motion needs full-cycle and intended-distance review; no actual substrate contact is shown.

source_review.observed: Independent claw positions change while shell and support-leg silhouette remain stable; Sleep brings the claws lower.
source_review.follow_up: Dark triangular openings are visible around both claw ends across frames; determine retained mesh opening versus overlap before declaring a defect. No surface contact proof.

source_review.observed: Fore/hind wing angles differ at opposite phases and head lowers in Sleep; the body silhouette is retained.
source_review.follow_up: Fore/hind wing overlap produces a dark band already present at Idle00. Side/native motion comparison is needed to distinguish underside shadow from sheet intersection. Feed coil motion is subtle.

source_review.observed: Anterior suction ring and segment curvature change slightly; Sleep lowers/tilts the ring.
source_review.follow_up: Sleep50 exposes a dark separation at the mouth-ring/body junction, less exposed in Idle00/25/75 and Investigate50. Retained-versus-candidate comparison required.

source_review.observed: Head and tail positions change subtly between quarters; Sleep visibly lowers the head and eyelids. Limbs and dorsal plates remain coherent in these views.
source_review.follow_up: Feed remains close to idle at this sample. Companion scale/facing, pet/feed contact and actual floor contact remain separate unverified scopes.

source_review.observed: Foreleg angles change independently while the other leg silhouette is largely stable; Sleep lowers the head/chelicerae.
source_review.follow_up: Long legs cross in projection and some outer extremities approach/cross the frame boundary. Actual self/floor clearance and strand contact need native/context checks.
